purpose: Fail-closed publication policy for research-derived dashboard content. Separates context visibility from decision-signal authorization.

output_contract.context_only: Informative/candidate entries may be displayed with explicit research status and decision_weight=0
output_contract.excluded: FALSIFIED entries are audit-only and absent from live decision layers
output_contract.sizing_authorized: Only entries with both PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED and sizing_authorized=true
